mission_10: Building a production-ready outlier detection pipeline requires combining multiple algorithms into a unified system that handles diverse data types, provides interpretable results, and operates reliably at scale. An ensemble approach that combines Isolation Forest, LOF, and statistical methods leverages the strengths of each algorithm while mitigating their individual weaknesses. Robust scaling ensures that features are on comparable scales without being distorted by outliers. Ensemble voting (requiring agreement from multiple methods) reduces false positives while maintaining high recall. Severity scores provide a continuous measure of outlierness for prioritization and triage. Automated reporting generates actionable insights about detected outliers, including which features contributed most to the anomaly score. This comprehensive approach transforms outlier detection from a one-off analysis into a reliable, repeatable component of production data pipelines.
